script.base: Spread and total are not saved, so this is not a blowout call and skill-2's dog-throws / leader-runs rule cannot be pinned to a side. Through two games Atlanta is a Bijan Robinson offense (37 carries, 155 rush yards, 14 targets at -18 air yards) with Brian Robinson mixing in (20 carries, 82 yards) and a thin pass game (Drake London 9 targets, 80 yards). Green Bay is vertical: Christian Watson 19 targets for 188 yards and Matthew Golden 18 for 153, and Jayden Reed (8 targets, 24 yards) is out. Green Bay has allowed 3.05 rush YPC and only 2 passes of 20-plus; Atlanta has allowed 8 passes of 20-plus and a 14.12 middle YPA. Base flow: a competitive, identity game — Green Bay throws at Atlanta's explosive leak with Golden/Watson holding Reed's vacated routes, Atlanta tries to run into that 3.05 YPC front, and Atlanta's WR/TE lines stay modest unless the score forces throws.
script.flip1: Aaron Banks (G) and Zach Bako-Bewele (T) are out, so pressure arrives without Atlanta needing to blitz (Atlanta blitzes only 21%). Golden and Watson's air-yard roles stall, Tucker Kraft (9 targets, 80 yards) and the backs' checkdowns rise, and if Green Bay still leads they close with Marshawn Lloyd (19 carries, 57 yards) and Chris Brooks.
script.flip2: Atlanta falls behind and abandons the run. Brian Robinson's carries die, Bijan's rush yards die with them, and London, Jahan Dotson (7 targets, 100 air yards, only 30 receiving yards) and Kyle Pitts become the attempt sponges. A shootout version of this flip hits Green Bay and Atlanta pass overs together and busts any Atlanta WR under.

pre_mortem: It's Monday and both leans lost. Golden finished under 55.5 because Banks and Bako-Bewele were out, Atlanta's four-man rush still got home, and Reed's targets became Kraft and Lloyd checkdowns — 58 was the real baseline and 95 was the spike, and a fair -113 price had no margin for that. London went over 67 because Atlanta trailed, the two quiet games were the trap, and he found Green Bay's middle (9.75 YPA on 8 throws) for one chunk on top of a 45-yard day. No sim was available to veto either hand read, and London never had a price to beat.
slip_story: Do not parlay them. Golden over is the GB-vertical story (Reed out, Atlanta's 8 explosives, 21% blitz). London under is the GB-perimeter story (5.7 outside YPA, 35% blitz, 4.5 targets). They fit together only in a GB-efficient game that is not a shootout; the shootout flip helps Golden and kills London. Do not add Watson (41-yard floor, same OL risk), Atlanta RB overs (need Atlanta to stay on schedule), or a total over. Single-story card, max one of these if the human keeps a lean after the flag.
